extraction.experiment: Sweeping the driving frequency ω traces the amplitude curve of Eq. 15.29, which peaks at the natural frequency ω_0. Raising the damping b lowers that peak and widens it, which is the behaviour shown in Figure 15.31.
extraction.reproduce: Driving at the natural frequency gives the maximum amplitude A_max = F_0/(bω). With m = k = F_0 = 1 and b = 0.1, this is about 10 at ω = ω_0 = 1.
extraction.contrast: With four times the damping, the same oscillator has a much lower and much wider resonance peak.
